newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha sinks with crude, supply good.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha sinks with crude, supply good.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were weaker on Friday as crude oil futures sagged, traders said.
Dealers said they saw usual supplies of Skikda material available although active offers were harder to pin down. Moroccan and Greek cargoes were also available, and this was adding to pressure.
Demand for n+a naphtha is still poor, and the market is seen still as oversupplied, with no prospect of a respite given falls on Friday on the barge market.
